topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I woke to silence, a heavy blanket over my thoughts. The driveway was empty, a stark patch of concrete where my car should have been. The tow truck’s absence gnawed at the edges of my mind, a riddle without an answer. I paced the house, checking windows, as if the car might reappear with a turn of my head. The hurried scribbles on the pink slip only deepened the shadows under my eyes. I called the usual places, my voice a tight knot, but the lines were cold, unyielding. Time dripped like acid, each second eroding what little patience I had left. I needed my car back, more than I realized, the world outside feeling as dangerous as an untamed sea.
